concern: Explain to a newcomer what Representation Router is: how it turns a semantic model plus a stakeholder concern into a routed, ranked representation choice, and how that choice becomes a concrete implementation with its own quality checks.
stakeholder: engineer or agent evaluating whether to adopt this tool
focus: Keep the pipeline stages as stable, distinct nodes; show the same use case flowing through the pipeline and branching into multiple ranked candidates rather than a single forced output.
successCriteria: A first-time reader can state, in their own words, what input the router takes and what kind of output it produces
A first-time reader can name at least two things that change which representation gets recommended
